mapper.update: UPDATE users SET user_status = 'A', user_withdrawn_at = NULL WHERE user_num = #{userNum} AND user_status = 'W'
mapper.select: SELECT user_num FROM users WHERE user_status = 'W' AND user_withdrawn_at < #{purgeBefore}
mapper.delete: DELETE av FROM auth_verifications av JOIN users u ON u.user_email = av.email WHERE u.user_num = #{userNum}
